Specification: This specification models a binary hour clock in which the variable bits represents an array of binary digits encoding an hour value. The module defines a helper operator to interpret a bit array as a numeric value, then relates that interpreted value to an hour variable through a temporal invariant stating that the hour always equals the value computed from bits. The top-level formula existentially quantifies an hour variable and combines that relation with the imported HourClock instance's HC property, so the design connects a binary representation of hours to an abstract hour-clock specification.
IfThenElse: IF  i=0  THEN  b[0] * 2^0  ELSE  (b[i] * 2^i) + val[i-1]
FunctionConstructor: [i \in 0..n |-> IF  i=0  THEN  b[0] * 2^0  ELSE  (b[i] * 2^i) + val[i-1]]
